name: Postman
summary: Postman is an API client with request building, collections, environments and a collection runner. The Free plan has one user. Solo costs $9 a month and Team $19 per user a month, both billed annually, and the page names no currency.

facts.text: Postman says collection runs can be started by hand in the Collection Runner, scheduled in Postman Cloud, run from the Postman CLI in a pipeline, or run as monitors.
GraphQL and gRPC collection runs need a paid plan.
The Free plan covers 1 user, 1,000 monitoring requests per team per month, 10,000 Postman API calls a month and 1-day collection recovery.
Postman's 2025 State of the API report surveyed over 5,700 developers, architects and executives, and reports that 93% of API teams still face collaboration blockers.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1 user, 1,000 monitoring requests per team per month, 10,000 Postman API calls a month. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Solo
plans.notes: Billed annually; the page shows no monthly-billing price. 1 user, 10,000 monitoring requests per team per month, 30-day collection recovery. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Billed annually; the page shows no monthly-billing price. Unlimited users, 10,000 monitoring requests per team per month, 90-day collection recovery. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. 10 million Postman API calls a month and pooled AI credits

hiddenCosts: AI credits beyond the monthly allowance cost $0.05 each on Solo and $0.04 on Team.
Cloud performance testing is charged at $0.04 per virtual user hour on Team and Enterprise.
